<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/policies/{siteId}/{sku}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Removes the policy of a site and SKU, given `If-Match: <version>` (a stale
value is a 409 `concurrent-modification`). Every open request of that
site and SKU is cancelled with reason `POLICY_REMOVED` in the same
transaction. Without a policy the pick face reports `NO_POLICY` and
raises no request.
